name: Valter Lobo
description: Enjoy a free concert from the talented singer-songwriter Valter Lobo as part of the intimate Porto Sounds Secret series.
longDescription:
Valter Lobo, the acclaimed Portuguese singer-songwriter, performs a free concert at Quinta de Salgueiros on July 12, 2026. This event is part of the Porto Sounds Secret series, an initiative designed to offer intimate musical experiences in unique locations across the city. Lobo is known for his introspective lyrics and melancholic melodies, drawing comparisons to artists within the indie-folk and alternative pop genres. His discography includes several critically well-received albums, establishing him as a significant voice in contemporary Portuguese music.

Attendees can expect an evening of live music in the intimate setting of Quinta de Salgueiros. The atmosphere is typically relaxed and appreciative, focusing on the musical performance. The event is open to all ages, attracting an audience interested in contemporary Portuguese music and unique cultural experiences. The performance will be conducted in Portuguese, reflecting Lobo's native language and artistic expression.

Admission to this concert is free. Given the nature of the Porto Sounds Secret series, early arrival is advisable to secure a good viewing spot. Quinta de Salgueiros is located in Porto and can be reached via public transport. Specific bus routes serving the area are recommended for direct access.
